create_Speech2TextProcessor: create a Speech2TextProcessor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer
call_Speech2TextProcessor_audio: call the processor with audio input and sampling rate to extract features
call_Speech2TextProcessor_text: call the processor with text input to tokenize and encode
call_Speech2TextProcessor_both: call the processor with both audio and text to extract features and generate labels
test_Speech2TextProcessor_no_input: test the processor raises ValueError when neither audio nor text is provided
